content.text: Diagnosis: the offline font charset omitted [ ] | # and the prompt string is 4 chars too wide at scale 3. Patch: regenerate the font literal with the extended charset '[]|#&;~', shorten the prompt line to '~$ agent run --goal: "just clear my inbox"' in a brighter dim-green (96,140,98), bump DIM to (82,118,84). Applying the patch to main.py.
